title: CLAUDE.md
text: fdic R package providing tibble-returning interface FDIC BankFind Suite API. exposes eight get_*() functions, one per API endpoint (demographics, failures, financials, history, institutions, locations, sod, summary), plus internal helper no_creds_available().

title: CLAUDE.md
text: package deliberately thin. Understanding requires reading R/aaa.R one get_*() file together: get_fdic() R/aaa.R single engine. Every public get_*() function thin wrapper sets endpoint <- "<name>" forwards arguments get_fdic(). get_fdic() builds httr2 request, performs , requests CSV format, parses response tibble, handles error/warning cases. change request-building, parsing, error handling, edit get_fdic(), individual wrappers. public functions share six arguments: api_key, filters, fields, sort_by, descending, limit. Roxygen docs use @inheritParams get_demographics inherit — get_demographics canonical source parameter documentation, edit roxygen block change shared docs. get_financials() wrapper extra logic: 250 fields requested, limit capped 500 (aborts otherwise). check runs wrapper get_fdic() called. filters uses Elasticsearch Query String Syntax (e.g. "STALP:NY ACTIVE:1"), passed verbatim API. fields sort_by upcased sending. Validation lives validate_query_params(). Field-definition datasets. eight fdic_* data objects data/ (e.g. fdic_financials) document valid field names per endpoint. built artifacts, regenerated live FDIC YAML specs data-raw/fdic_api_definitions.R (requires purrr, yaml, dplyr, usethis — Suggests/dev-). roxygen docs live R/data.R.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Functions read API key FDIC_API_KEY environment variable default (Sys.getenv("FDIC_API_KEY")), overridable via api_key argument. api_key required: FDIC announced September 8, 2026 longer accepts unauthenticated requests, check_api_key() R/aaa.R aborts api_key missing empty rather warning falling back degraded -key/"DEMO_KEY" mode. no_creds_available() exported purely tests can skip_if() key present.

what: Filtering Using Elasticsearch Query String Syntax
title: fdic
text: FDIC Bank Suite API uses Elasticsearch Query String Syntax filter results. text: api_key (String) FDIC API key. Required: FDIC accept unauthenticated requests. Defaults value FDIC_API_KEY environment variable. Register free personal key (1,000 req/hr) https://api.data.gov/signup/. filters (String) optional Elasticsearch query string filter results. field names values must uppercase. fields (String Character vector) Fields include response. ID column always present, regardless fields requested. retrieve recently published API definition endpoint, replace get_ prefix function name fdic_ (e.g., get_{endpoint}() fdic_{endpoint}()). sort_by (String) Field name sort results . Defaults API default sort order endpoint. descending (Logical) results sorted descending order? applies sort_by specified. Defaults FALSE. limit (Integer) Number records return. Must 1 10,000. Defaults 10,000.
